lines.text: Wait! Chameleons Don't Change Color Just to Hide!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why chameleons change color!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Chameleons mostly shift skin nanocrystals to control body temperature.
and signal moods like excitement, anger, or sunshine warmth.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Mood Colors!
